text.marquee: RANK UP CITY · BUILDING 2 · THE OFFICE TOWER
text.tagline:
Take the calls. Answer the emails.
Ace the interview.
text.taglineEs: Escucha, responde y arma frases. Suma patitas <ico-paw></ico-paw> en cada turno.
text.help: Easy: READ the message, then PICK the best reply — or TAP the words to build a sentence and hit SEND. Stuck? Enri's PURR BOOST gives you a hint. You've got this.
text.bossWin: YES! You did it — the Office Tower is yours. You're promoted! Rank up to B1. The Detective Agency is next... when you're ready.
text.gameOver: Hey — a tough first week gets EVERYBODY. Take a breath and run it back. Enri believes in you. Probably.

epic.name: ENRI
epic.quote: I don't chase success. I nap and it finds me.

common.name: OFFICE PASS
common.quote: Everyone starts on day one. Clock in and retry!

s1.name: First day
s1.intro: New hire! Welcome to the Office Tower. Up here it's calls, chats and emails — no coffee, but the game's the same: read the message, then PICK or BUILD the right English. Totti's still watching. Let's go.

rounds.line: Hi! I'm Sofia, the team lead. Welcome aboard! What do you usually do every morning before work?
rounds.retryLine: Every morning — your ROUTINE. What do you usually do?
rounds.thanks: Ha, a coffee person. We'll get along.
options: I usually check my email and make a coffee.
I checked my email yesterday.
I'm going to check my email.

rounds.line: Hey, I'm Marcos, a developer. We work from home on Fridays. How often do you work remotely?
rounds.retryLine: How OFTEN — once a week? Twice?
rounds.thanks: Same as me. The commute is brutal.
options: I work from home twice a week.
I worked from home last week.
I'm working from home now.

rounds.line: First task — reply to this email. Start it politely.
rounds.note: EMAIL — Hi, can you send the report? — Laura (client)

rounds.line: I just messaged you 'Welcome to the team!' on the chat. What do you reply?
options: Thanks, Marcos! Nice to meet you.
You're welcome, Marcos!
Welcome, Marcos! Nice to meet you.

rounds.line: Now finish the email. Sign off like a professional.

s2.name: Work stories
s2.intro: Coffee break — well, virtual coffee. The team swaps work stories, and it's all PAST tense up here: worked, built, didn't. Listen and answer.

rounds.line: So, before this job — where did you work?
rounds.thanks: A startup! Same as me. Small world.
options: I worked at a small startup for two years.
I work at a startup.
I'm working at a startup.

rounds.line: Nice. Tell me what you did there — build the sentence.
rounds.answer: I built websites and fixed bugs
alts: I fixed bugs and built websites

rounds.line: And why did you leave your last job?
rounds.retryLine: Why did you LEAVE? A past reason.
rounds.thanks: Makes sense. Their loss, our gain.
options: The project finished, so I looked for something new.
The project finishes next week.
I don't leave my job.

rounds.line: One more — make it negative. You didn't study computer science, right?
Quick one — did you finish the report I sent yesterday?
options: Yes, I did. I sent it back this morning.
Yes, I do.
Yes, I will finish it.

s3.name: The client call
s3.intro: Big moment — a client's on the line. Be POLITE: could, would, can. And she'll compare our plans, so know your comparatives. Breathe. Totti's listening.

rounds.line: Hello, this is Laura, the client. Could you send me your two plans?
rounds.retryLine: Be polite and helpful — you'd be happy to…
options: Of course — I'd be happy to send them right now.
No, send them yourself.
I sent them yesterday.

rounds.line: Thanks. Which plan is cheaper?
options: The Basic plan is cheaper than the Pro plan.
The Basic plan is the cheapest.
The Basic plan is more cheap.

rounds.line: And why is the Pro plan better? Tell me.
rounds.answer: The Pro plan is more powerful

rounds.line: Good. Could you start the project next week?
options: Yes, we could start on Monday.
Yes, we start yesterday.
No, we can't never.

rounds.line: Close the call politely — offer to help more.
rounds.retryLine: Offer more help — 'Please call me if…'.
rounds.answer: Please call me if you need help
alts: If you need help please call me

s4.name: The big project
s4.intro: We won the client! Now we plan the project. Talk FUTURE: 'going to', and present continuous for arrangements. Let's build it.

rounds.line: So — what's the plan? When are we going to start?
options: We're going to start on Monday.
We started on Monday.
We start Monday always.

rounds.line: Put my task on the board. I'm building the app this week.
rounds.thanks: On it. Added to the board.
rounds.answer: I am building the app this week
alts: This week I am building the app

rounds.line: One more question — what are you doing on Friday?
rounds.thanks: Big day. I'll bring the pizza.
options: We're launching the app on Friday.
We launched the app on Friday.
We launch always on Friday.

rounds.line: Tell the team the goal. Use 'going to'.
rounds.answer: We are going to finish on time

rounds.line: Last thing — are you nervous about the launch?
rounds.retryLine: Predict the future — 'it's going to be…'.
options: A little, but I think it's going to be great.
Yes, it was great.
No, I launched it yesterday.

sb.name: The interview
sb.intro: This is it. The Director came down for your interview — everything you've learned: your past, polite requests, comparisons, your plans. Ace it and you rank up to B1. Go get it.

rounds.line: Let's begin. Tell me about your last job.
options: I worked at a startup, where I built websites.
I work at a startup now.
I'm going to work at a startup.

rounds.line: Everyone says they work hard. Prove it — one thing you did last year.
rounds.retryLine: Past simple, and add a time marker.
rounds.answer: Last year I finished a big project
alts: I finished a big project last year

rounds.line: Could you work under pressure, with a hard deadline?
options: Yes, I could. I work well with deadlines.
Yes, I can yesterday.
No, I couldn't never.

rounds.line: Why are you better than the other candidates?
rounds.answer: I learn faster than the others

rounds.line: Final question. Where do you see yourself next year?
rounds.thanks: ...The job is yours. Welcome to B1. Rank up, rookie.
options: I'm going to grow and take on bigger projects.
I grew last year.
I don't know nothing.
